_note: The War Room's What's New?! board (WhatsNewDialog). `current` is this build's version (project.godot application/config/version must match; validate_data checks). Releases newest first. An item is a line of text, or {"label", "text"} for a bold lead-in, with optional "items" indented under it. `next` is the What's Next?! roadmap: `updates` (version, kind "minor"/"major", when, items) in planned order, then loose `items`. Text: Logan, 2026-10-14.

items.label: New Art!
items: Data Archives and Mining Grounds combat backgrounds
Every event scene
12 new component portraits
War Room stations: Directives, Pilot Log, Memorial Wall, Info Bay and Livery Bay
Snow and dust weather in combat
Game icon
Trismeg Studio intro screen

items.label: Balance:
items.text: tuned some deployment orders and enemy loadouts, and enemies no longer waste their own parts.

items.label: Combat:
items.text: hover an enemy part to see its cards. Enemies with nothing left to play retreat, and status effects have their own icons.

items.label: New:
items.text: name your War Room, a new run summary, and this What's New?! board.

releases.title: First Release
items: Added another card to every hardpoint and protocol.
Balanced every card to give each one more trade-offs and you more options.
Enemies now have their own strategies and play more varied turns.
Send feedback from in-game, and a Discord server
Better icons for enemy intents and statuses
Steam Deck compatibility
Steam Cloud saves, so your progress follows you between PCs
A Steam store page with wishlists

items.label: New mission types:
items: Research Runs to unlock new mechs
Backline Blitz: only elites and bosses, for bigger Chip rewards
More parts to unlock as you play
Bigger boss fights
And much more, including your feedback!
